can_label.fine: Contents under pressure. Keep away from heat, sparks and open flame. Do not pierce or burn, even when empty. Use in a ventilated place. Shake for one minute before use. Spectra FX. Not for food contact.

tags.description: A Spectra party can, holographic glitter in a clear base. The colours slide through the rainbow as you walk past and the glitter catches every light. Sprays holo. Nobody sells them any more.
